Version discovery + install engine for the clue package manager.

Discovery is fast: versions and parsed deps are cached in the versions DB table, so repeat installs need zero network and zero re-parsing. Versions are read from the remote (git ls-remote --tags) only when a package isn't cached yet, and locally (git tag --list) once cloned.

Imports

configs, resolver, nimbleparser

Types

DepEntry = tuple[name: string, version: string]
A resolved dependency entry for the installed manifest. 
DiscoveredVersion = object
  version*: Version
  tag*: string
GitHeadInfo = object
  hash*: string              ## full commit hash of the latest commit
  date*: string              ## ISO-8601 committer date
  author*: string            ## committer name
  subject*: string           ## first line of the commit message
InstalledRecord = object
  version*: string
  path*: string
  root*: bool

Vars

devShadowWarningsEnabled = false
Build commands enable this when --verbose is passed; the shadow warning would otherwise interleave with the live spinner line on a plain build.

Clone (or refresh) a package repository into the cache, preferring SSH and falling back to HTTPS. On an existing cache dir only refresh touches the network (incremental git fetch --tags); offline installs reuse the clone. nonInteractive suppresses prompts and failure warnings (used during version discovery where a dead URL just means "no versions").

Discover all semver versions for a package, newest first. Serves from the DB cache unless refresh is set. On a cache miss the package is cloned into _cache (first time only) and versions are read from its local git tags — no network afterwards; with refresh an existing clone is fetched (git fetch --tags) so new remote tags are picked up. With cloneOnMiss = false (the clue versions query) it lists the remote without cloning.

    name: string; versions: int; cached: bool) = nil): Table[string,
    seq[DiscoveredVersion]] {....raises: [OSError, IOError, StoreError, WalError,
                                       Exception, KeyError, ValueError,
                                       JsonParsingError, InvalidVersionError], tags: [
    WriteDirEffect, ReadDirEffect, WriteIOEffect, ReadIOEffect, RootEffect,
    TimeEffect, ExecIOEffect], forbids: [].}
Discover versions for many packages at once. The clone-and-list steps run concurrently on a thread pool; DB cache writes happen sequentially on the caller's thread since the store isn't thread-safe. onDone is called on the caller's thread as each package finishes (for live progress), with cached true when it was served from the local DB (no network). With refresh existing clones are fetched (git fetch --tags) so new remote tags are picked up for every package.
